fact: On 20 May 2026 the Ministry of Economy, Finances and Budget launched SICOM, a property-accounting system developed in-house by its national IT directorate (DNSI) with the accounting directorate and covering 24 ministries.
title: Modernisation des Finances Publiques : La Guinée lance SICOM, son nouvel outil numérique souverain de gestion du patrimoine public
